title: Daughtrey v. Ashe — a specific description
shortTitle: Daughtrey v. Ashe — a specific description
summary: The notes contrast a jeweler’s specific statement of diamond quality with general commendation.
notes:
Casebook discussion of a shorter authority.

The comparison tests whether a statement is a description or affirmation forming part of the bargain and how the speaker’s expertise affects its meaning. It does not supply a complete opinion or a universal rule about every expression of expertise.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 7–8. Open assigned page 7.
